verdict.rationale: Scheduled sending and undo-send are fair questions for an email-sending API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a send-at-time parameter or a send-cancellation grace window. The Drafts human-review workflow is a related feature but is neither a schedule nor an undo, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
